blurb: The open, parkland style design is challenging and fun to all skill levels. With no homes on the course, your round will not be hindered by narrowing fairways and curious onlookers. The unique par 72 course layout features five par 5′s and five par 3′s - designed to provide an exceptional golf experience for all levels of play.
